description: This Java source file defines an abstract assertion class for verifying the properties of CommandResponse objects in testing frameworks. It provides various methods to assert expected values for response type, name, headers, status, resource path, and manifest.

classes.name: AbstractCommandResponseAssert
classes.description: An abstract assertion class for CommandResponse objects, providing methods to verify various properties of command responses in tests.

methods.name: hasType
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the specified type.

methods.name: hasName
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the specified name.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasEmptyDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has empty DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the specified correlation ID.

methods.name: hasJsonSchemaVersion
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the specified JSON schema version.

methods.name: containsAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse contains the specified authorization subject(s).

methods.name: hasStatus
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the specified HTTP status code.

methods.name: hasStatusCode
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the specified status code value.

methods.name: assertThatEquals
methods.description: Helper method to assert equality of properties with custom error messages.

methods.name: hasResourcePath
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the specified resource path.

methods.name: hasManifest
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the specified manifest string.
